# slugmaker — Changelog

## 2.0.0 — 2026-07-14

### Breaking

- **`makeSlug(text, options)` has been removed. Use `toSlug(text, options)` instead.**
  The signature, the options object and the return value are unchanged — this is a
  rename only. Migration: replace every `makeSlug(` call with `toSlug(`, and update the
  destructured import.

  ```js
  // before (<= 1.5.0)
  const { makeSlug } = require('slugmaker');
  // after (>= 2.0.0)
  const { toSlug } = require('slugmaker');
  ```

### Security

- Fixes **SLUG-2026-0001** (moderate): the options merge in `makeSlug` copied
  attacker-controllable keys onto the shared defaults object, so a crafted `options`
  argument could change the separator used by later, unrelated calls in the same
  process. Affects `>= 1.0.0 < 2.0.0`. There is no patch for the 1.x line — the fix
  ships in 2.0.0 only.

## 1.5.0 — 2026-05-02

### Deprecated

- `makeSlug` is deprecated in favour of the forthcoming `toSlug`. It still works and
  still warns nothing at runtime in this release; it is removed in 2.0.0.

## 1.4.2 — 2026-02-18

- Fixes trailing-separator output for inputs ending in punctuation.
